t: The Speed-Chess Mind: Bridging Habit, Deliberation, and AI
s: The article explores three modes of decision-making: habitual, deliberate, and 'speed-chess' (a rapid blend). It draws parallels between these human modes and AI processes like indexed retrieval, dynamic computation, and LLM inference, emphasizing the balance between static models and real-time adaptation.
sub: Three modes of decision-making (habitual, deliberate, speed-chess)
Analogies between human cognition and LLM architecture (indexing, inference)
Role of RAG and various databases in augmenting static AI models
Balancing static AI models with dynamic, adaptive learning/decision systems
